For most deciduous trees, late winter to early spring is ideal for pruning in St Leonards. This period, before new growth emerges, allows trees to heal quickly and reduces the risk of disease transmission.

Evergreen trees, common in St Leonards gardens, can be pruned almost any time of year, but avoiding extreme heat in summer is advisable. Pruning in autumn can help maintain shape before the cooler months.
